blocks.rationale: Create the requested two-rule graph: a nonnative helper determines whether Paragraph 4(a)'s representative exception overlaps the recipient category described by the current disclosure query, and a terminal helper applies Paragraph 3(c)'s general prohibition subject to that exception. This directly corrects nda-7 while retaining nda-5.

inputs.name: current_question
inputs.question: What is the current disclosure-permission proposition whose recipient category must be tested against the Representatives exception?

skill.intent: Determine whether a disclosure query concerns at least one recipient class permitted by the contractual Representatives exception.

outputs.description: Whether Paragraph 4(a) permits disclosure to at least one recipient category encompassed by the current proposition.
outputs.name: exception_applies

origin.quote: Subject to the restrictions set forth below in this Section 4

source_obligations.statement: Treat Paragraph 4(a) as a qualified exception to the nondisclosure rule, rather than as an unrestricted authorization for every third party.
